Watch "Irulu Neelum Raave" Video Song from Ezra, a Horror Thriller starring Prithviraj Sukumaran, Priya Anand, Tovino Thomas, Sujith Shanker, Vijayaraghavan among others. Directed by Jay K, Cinematography done by Sujith Vasudev, Edited by Vivek Harshan & Produced by Mukesh M Mehta, C V Sarathy, A V Anoop under the banner of E4 Entertainment & AVA Productions. Muzik247 is the Official Music label for Ezra. Official Online Partner - POFFACTIO
Song: Irulu Neelum Raave
Singer: Sachin Balu
Music Director: Sushin Shyam
Lyricist: Vinayak Sasikumar
Mixed by Abin Paul
Mastered by Shadab Rayeen
